M4b-3 (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 21, the Owner's answers Q1 = B and Q2 = B of 2026-11-21): a reading frame whose first part, from the frame's start, runs into a mask that runs to the frame's end is searched over that part, each HSP written once, with NCBI's bytes or, with ncbi-near:, those of NCBI's run of the near input (th2tn: the mask 4 bases shorter, the freed bases stored as N). M4b-3c (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 27, the Owner's answer Q4 = B of 2026-11-22): a mask that leaves a reading frame an empty first part (te 13, 14, 15, 31; tq4's empty mask at 0), on which NCBI crashes, is searched as the frame's chunks give it, the masked bases masked in every frame, with the bytes of NCBI's run of the near input (te13n, te14n, te15n, te31n, tq4n: the mask removed, its bases stored as N; ../db_search/make_dbmaskt_q4.py).
